about_the_game:
In the year 2035, you're not a soldier, explorer, or hero — you're entertainment. Passion Rift drops you into the world’s biggest reality show, where fantasy races, corporate conspiracies, and interdimensional horrors collide — along with temptation, rivalry, and desire.

A mysterious portal has opened on a tropical island in the Seychelles. Bought for billions and transformed into a luxury resort and broadcast hub, the island is now the heart of Passion Rift — a deadly show where participants venture into alien dimensions searching for fame, treasure, thrills… and maybe a little pleasure.

Thousands of years ago, the portal first touched our world, merging realms and races. Now elves take selfies, goblins shop online, and orcs argue on forums. But stepping through the Rift still means danger, glory... and cameras rolling — even when the lights go down.
Every step is filmed. Every decision has a cost

  •  Reality show survival – compete, progress, and become a global star… or die trying.

  •  Explore alien worlds – dangerous dimensions filled with monsters, tech, and secrets.

  •  Character progression – unlock skills, gear, perks, and rise to global fame.

  •  Idle combat – assemble your squad and let them battle through waves of enemies using unique skills and synergies.

  •  Flirt system – build bonds, unlock dialogues, and collect sexy outfits for each girl.

  • Corporate intrigue – uncover the dark truth behind the portal and the show's creators.

Over 18 girls from all over the world — and from wildly different fantasy races — have joined the show alongside you. Elves, goblins, orcs, mutants and more, each with unique looks, outfits, and personalities — from shy to dominant, sweet to chaotic.
Form bonds through choices, gifts, and flirty banter. Unlock private scenes and stylish and revealing outfits. Some might want your heart. Others just want a taste of the spotlight — or you.

Your relationships might just help you survive… or complicate everything.

Will they fall for your charm — or leave you behind?
